reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #2 'Inventing Double-Opt-In Credit' is a completed 2019 ConsenSys Labs Open Finance hackathon bounty challenge, not a concrete code change to this repository. (1) The issue body is an open-ended hackathon call for submissions ('product' + 'potential'); it explicitly accepts 'wireframes, landing page, prototypes, or production code' plus a report/presentation/video and requires market research, an SME advisor testimonial, and proof blockchain adds value. Submission deadline was 11:59 PM EDT 2019-04-30. This is a generic product idea / design-marketing deliverable with no reproducible defect or focused engineering feature to implement. (2) Funding is completed/withdrawn: gitcoinbot comment id 492375379 (2019-05-14T19:24:24Z) states 'This Bounty has been completed.', and the 36 ETH funding was fully paid out as tips on 2019-05-14 to owans (6 ETH), ugolino (6 ETH), tspoff (6 ETH), drdgvhbh (6 ETH), tobyjaguar (2+2 ETH), cs79 (1.99 ETH). (3) The target already has competing submissions merged into this repo under double-opt-in-credit/ (LandBrokes, SmartPiggies, double-dabble, enable) via PRs #3-#11, plus a referenced external submission PR (aj07/Dcred, issue comment id 492369657). The repository is a submission-collection repo (readme.md: 'Submitting Open Finance Bounties') with no root build/test/lint/CI infrastructure. The fix/bounty-2 branch contains zero product edits; no baseline or regression commands were run because fabricating a regression plan would turn a rejected/non-engineering, completed-funding issue into a fallback proposal.
